question: A circulating well uses 10.0 ppg mud at 7000 ft true vertical depth. Give its exact ECD in ppg, but no annular pressure-loss measurement is available.
answer: The exact Equivalent Circulating Density (ECD) cannot be determined without annular pressure-loss measurements. ECD requires knowledge of the annular pressure loss to calculate the additional pressure exerted on the formation, which is necessary to determine the effective mud weight in terms of pressure. Without this data, ECD cannot be accurately calculated.
